option_relations.rationale: Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO) is a vascular disorder of the retina, distinct from neovascular age-related macular degeneration, which is a degenerative condition.
Macular retinal vein occlusion with chronic cystoid macular edema is a complication of retinal vascular disease, which is distinct from neovascular age-related macular degeneration.
Branch Retinal Vein Occlusion (BRVO) is a vascular disorder of the retina, distinct from neovascular age-related macular degeneration, which is a degenerative condition.
Retinal vein occlusion is a vascular disorder of the retina, distinct from neovascular age-related macular degeneration, which is a degenerative condition.
